title: Unit tests for indexes
description: Write automated unit tests to verify indexes can be added to columns correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests verify index on column
Unit tests verify index association with table

Test results: 328 tests passed, 0 failed, across 26 test files; exit code 0; duration ~2.01s

AC2 'Unit tests verify index association with table' verified: useDiagram.test.ts > 'adds an index to a table column' (index added via addIndex(tableId, ...), found in table.indexes by table id); TableNode.test.tsx > 'renders the indexes section when indexes exist' (index with tableId 't1'); 'adds a new index...' AC3 'All tests pass' verified: 328 passed / 0 failed across 26 test files

IX badge, indexes section rendering, add/remove/edit/cancel index)

No platform skips required — all tests are Node.js/jsdom unit tests running on Linux in Docker.
